==Description==
The '''Eggmin Cannon 9000''' was a gear published to the Roblox catalog on the 6th of April 2020, specifically for the Roblox event, [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] As Tower Defense Simulator was part of this event, this gear had some use in the game. You can no longer use this gear in Tower Defense Simulator.

==Usage==
Using the '''Eggmin Cannon 9000''', you could shoot out the [[w:c:Roblox:Catalog:Eleggtrifying Eggmin of 2020|Eleggtrifying Eggmin of 2020]] for you and other players to obtain.

==Trivia==
*Only Roblox administrators and Quality Assurance Testers can own this gear.
*The '''Eggmin Cannon 9000''' could only be used in the Tower Defense Simulator lobby between the 6th of April 2020, and the 29th of April 2020.
**After 29 April 2020, the '''Eggmin Cannon 9000''' could no longer be used, although the [[Spring 2020 Event]] still continued.
*The '''Eggmin Cannon 9000''' can still be used in other games that allow for it, though its primary function is now depreciated.
*''Eggmin'' is a portmanteau of "egg" and "admin".
